other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Background mention of continuous ventilation and 24/7 operation in university laboratories.
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Laboratories exhibit 3–10 times higher energy
intensity than classrooms due to continuous ventilation requirements, 24/7 operations,
and specialized equipment loads

one_line: Systematic review of energy efficiency interventions in Latin American university buildings, emphasizing simulation models, lighting, HVAC, and photovoltaics in highland climates.
